text: Chapter 9: Recapturing Eldenbaum@The Teleporter Left Behind

Head towards Old Lufenas Mansion Ruins to find a teleporter
that can probably be used to transport reinforcement troops
to Eldenbaum! You can enter Old Lufenas Mansion Ruins from
Recetacula Sector.
The invention was left in the basement area that is\nsomewhere in the mansion precincts. Find the entrance!
No one knows where exactly in the basement area\nthe teleporter is. Search thoroughly!
Defeat the Coenubia in front of the teleporter and\nget the device to work!
[[N]]Go to Deltzon Research Zone: Deepest Area
